response.sql: WITH combo AS (SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM combo), withavg AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_margin_over_avg_share FROM withavg WHERE share > avg_share GROUP BY tradekind
